context:
Start from the existing Home and MetaLeaderboard tests, then make the smallest
design-system-aligned changes that remove the PR #246 interpretation risks.
Use shared tokens/primitives from the retheme foundation. Keep the dense
data table scannable; do not trade metric clarity for a marketing-style
layout.
description:
PR #246 added a focused Results Explorer audit for visual hierarchy,
usability, and data-presentation quality. The Home leaderboard remains the
public first read of BenchBox results, and the audit found that its focus
state, metric context, filter/control hierarchy, heatmap, links, and badge
treatments compete in ways that can mislead users.

This TODO turns the PR #246 evidence into an implementation plan for Home and
MetaLeaderboard. It should be executed with the existing retheme foundation,
but the acceptance criteria here are deliberately screenshot-bound: the
implementation is not done until the named PR #246 screenshots can be
recaptured without the observed issues.

anti_patterns.dont: hide metric direction in title attributes only; use visible text or a visible legend.
make missing runs look like zero-duration or slow-duration runs.
make trust, validation, computed, warning, and success states all green pills.
remove keyboard grid navigation while fixing focus styling.
use focus rings to indicate best value, active mode, selected data, hover, or loaded state.

preserves.behavior: Clickable cohort headers and receipt/result links.
Coverage semantics: missing cohorts are not scored and remain visible separately.
Existing `/results/` route and Home URL mode contract.
Keyboard navigation for the leaderboard grid.

verifications.description: Home and MetaLeaderboard unit/a11y tests pass

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run test:e2e:fixtures && npm run build && npx playwright test --project=chromium --grep home
verifications.description: Home browser smoke covers all modes
verifications.expected: Chromium Home smoke passes for times, ranks, and speedup modes

verifications.command: echo 'Manual: recapture /results/ at 390, 768, 1280, 1600 in times/ranks/speedup and compare against PR #246 Home screenshots'
verifications.description: Manual PR #246 evidence recapture is clean
verifications.expected: manual evidence shows VH-1, VH-2, DQ-1, and DQ-2 resolved or explicitly deferred

work_units.summary: Reproduce and annotate the PR #246 Home evidence before editing

work_units.notes:
Update `MetaLeaderboard.tsx` so the first cell does not show a visible
focus ring on initial render. Internal roving-grid coordinates may still
exist, but the ring must be visible only after true keyboard focus enters
the grid. Active mode, hovered cells, selected/clicked cells, best values,
and focus-visible must have different visual treatments.

Acceptance evidence:
- recaptured `home-390.png` and `home-1280.png` equivalents show no
  initial blue ring before user input;
- keyboard Tab/arrow traversal still exposes a clear focus-visible state;
- screen-reader/ARIA grid behavior is not removed to fix styling.
work_units.summary: Separate roving focus, keyboard focus, selected state, and analytical emphasis

work_units.notes:
Every cohort header must make the comparison contract visible without
relying on title attributes. Include compact labels for benchmark, scale,
phase, metric family, unit, and direction. Examples:
  - TPC-H SF0.01, power score, higher is better;
  - geomean latency, ms, lower is faster;
  - speedup, ratio, above `1.00x` is faster and below `1.00x` is worse.

Keep labels short enough for 390px and 768px layouts. If the header
becomes too dense, use an adjacent visible legend rather than hiding the
meaning in tooltips.
work_units.summary: Add visible metric, unit, phase, and direction labels to cohort headers

work_units.notes:
Consolidate the active summary and cohort/filter selector into a single
analytical toolbar. The toolbar should make the primary page action
obvious: browse leaderboard, change metric mode, narrow cohorts, then
inspect or compare results. The sort control should not visually dominate
mode selection, especially on mobile.

Preserve URL contracts for `?mode=ranks` and `?mode=speedup`.
work_units.summary: Rebalance Home mode, sort, cohort, and filter controls

work_units.notes:
Define a cell hierarchy where the numeric value is the primary read,
heatmap color is secondary, and trust/validation/source metadata is
tertiary. Trust, validation, tuning, missing data, warning, and focus
states must not all use the same green or blue visual semantics.

Include a visible legend that explains heatmap meaning, missing runs,
coverage, validation/trust glyphs, and speedup values below `1.00x`.
work_units.summary: Redesign quantitative cells so values outrank heat, links, and badges
Add focused Home and MetaLeaderboard regression coverage

work_units.notes:
Capture Home screenshots at 390px, 768px, 1280px, and 1600px in times,
ranks, and speedup modes. Store evidence under `_project/audits/` and
